name: Pestis tertia (third European wave)
summary: Third pan-European outbreak of Yersinia pestis since 1347. Chronicles report ~10–15% additional mortality in affected regions, again with strong age-cohort selection.

_quarry.structural_significance: Reinforces the post-1347 demographic regime; combined with the 1361 wave, ensures the European population stays well below pre-Black-Death levels for two centuries.
